messages:
Alex M: Quick sync — we need to finalize retention & visibility for marketplace usage events. Partner asks to keep raw usage for 12 months in their portal, but our ledger only retains 90 days by default. Any objections to a 12mo mirror for partner-visible rows only?
Jordan: What exact rows would be mirrored? full event payloads or just aggregated monthly entries?
Alex M: Prefer we mirror event headers + SKU/quantity/timestamp + partner_event_id. No raw PII, no stack traces. So metadata only.
Rebecca: +1 on metadata-only. Also need to confirm encryption key scoping (customer-managed KMS?) for mirrored set.
Samir: From infra: storing 12mo increases cold storage costs but feasible. Two asks: 1) add a dedupe key (partner_event_id) to avoid replay duplicates; 2) TTL on mirrored rows at partner discretion via an API.
Alex M: Good — dedupe key is mandatory. Proposal: mirrored rows written to partners_ledger table with columns (partner_event_id, partner_id, sku, units, ts, source_region, signature) and a partner_retention_days column default 365.
Jordan: How do we guarantee visibility parity for entitlements? Partners expect entitlement activations to show immediately. Our current ingest pipeline ack window is 60s, replay backoff up to 10m.
Rebecca: We should treat entitlement activation events as high-priority: route them through the priority queue path so they bypass batching and hit partner mirror asap. That requires a routing flag on events.
Samir: Implementation note: priority path increases QPS on the hot path. Ops needs a knob to throttle for heavy bursts. Recommend soft-rate-limit per partner and a circuit-breaker to fallback to aggregated deltas when overloaded.
Alex M: Good call. Also let's lock down webhook retry semantics with partners: they want 10 attempts over 7 days. We currently do exponential backoff up to 6 attempts over 24h. Change approved?
Jordan: 10 attempts/7 days is okay if we add a missing-event reconciliation job that runs daily to avoid long-term discrepancies.
Rebecca: I'll draft the reconciliation job: daily join of partners_ledger vs internal_ledger by (partner_event_id) and produce a delta report. Pseudocode: 
```
SELECT p.partner_event_id, p.sku, p.units, i.units as internal_units
FROM partners_ledger p
LEFT JOIN internal_ledger i ON i.partner_event_id = p.partner_event_id
WHERE p.ts >= current_date - interval '1 day'
AND (i.partner_event_id IS NULL OR i.units != p.units);
```
Samir: Add another step: compute a signed-hash for each event and surface mismatches for manual review. That prevents tampering and helps debugging.
Alex M: Compliance check: make sure mirrored records are redacted for IP and user agent — only keep partner-provided identifiers and SKU. Legal OK with that? Rebecca can you confirm?
Rebecca: Confirmed. Redaction rules: no client IP, no auth headers, strip user_agent. Add audit log entries for any access to mirrored rows.
Jordan: Who owns the partner-facing retention UI to let partners set TTL per partner? Product or Partnerships?
Alex M: Partnerships to own partner-facing settings; Product to own API. Action: Partnerships to spec UI + API by EOW.
Samir: Ops actions: estimate additional S3/GCS and DB storage; add soft QPS throttles; implement dedupe check on write idempotency. ETA 2 weeks.
Rebecca: I'll start the reconciliation job PR and KMS scoping doc.
Alex M: Great. One more: metrics — we need partner-visible lag SLO (time from event to mirror). Propose p95 <= 45s for entitlement activations and p95 <= 5m for usage events. Agree?
Jordan: Those SLAs look realistic. I'll add dashboards and alerts.
Integrations Bot: [deploy-notice] partners-mirror-service v0.3.1 deployed to staging at 4212350000.
Alex M: Staging deploy looks good. Ok team — let's capture tasks: Partnerships spec UI/API (Rebecca), Recon job PR (Rebecca), Ops capacity + throttles (Samir), Dashboards + alerts (Jordan), Legal compliance signoff (Rebecca). Ping me if blockers. :thumbsup:
